items.title: Zcash developers want 20-second blocks just days after major speed upgrade
items.summary: Early data shows Zcash's orphan-block rate holding close to pre-upgrade levels despite blocks arriving three times faster, encouraging developers to push for another reduction.

items.title: Zcash devs propose another block time cut days after NU7 upgrade
items.summary: The proposed reduction aims to shorten transaction confirmation times and improve the user experience for point-of-sale payments, exchange deposits and cross-chain swaps.

items.title: tBTC bridge partially resumes as $120M Aave reserve remains frozen
items.summary: Threshold halted its tBTC bridge on Oct. 30 as operators addressed a critical Linux kernel vulnerability that could allow attackers to execute code on unpatched servers.

items.title: A Bitcoin block just neared a 2015 transaction record, but paid only $180 in fees
items.summary: The AntPool block came within 984 transactions of Bitcoin’s 2015 record, even as fees made up less than 0.1% of the miner’s payout.

items.title: Google’s AI chip push adds more pressure on Nvidia
items.summary: Google’s specialised AI chips threaten greater competition as Nvidia faces a leadership investigation.

items.title: North Korean hackers are creating memecoins to wash loot from $6.3 billion Binance hack
items.summary: North Korean hackers used six homemade memecoins to launder 117,000 NEAR, worth about $430,000, from the $6.3 billion Binance hack, Elliptic says.

items.title: NYSE picks Avalanche to settle tokenized stocks amid Wall Street's blockchain race
items.summary: Avalanche will serve as the core settlement ledger for the exchange's planned blockchain stock market

items.title: Solana set for its first tokenized stock venue under SEC framework, listing Galaxy
items.summary: Formation Securities plans to launch in early 2027 with Galaxy, Exodus and Forward Industries shares, expanding the U.S. regulator's experiment in blockchain-based stock trading.

items.title: Trump says he knows ‘nothing’ about World Liberty’s UAE ties as Justin Sun challenges filings
items.summary: Trump confirmed he co-owns World Liberty, whose UAE ownership could derail Justin Sun’s federal lawsuit over frozen WLFI tokens

items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 9, 2026

items.title: Nvidia-led tech selloff weighs on crypto majors
items.summary: Only five of the top 100 cryptocurrencies by market value are up 1% or more over the past 24 hours. That is the state of the market today.

items.title: Live news: Bitcoin narrows loss as Nasdaq surges more than 2%
items.summary: The Nasdaq and S&P 500 are both sharply higher even as Nvidia declines following CEO Jensen Huang's issues.

items.title: Coinbase gets full U.S. trust charter from federal banking regulator
items.summary: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency elevated the biggest U.S. exchange's trust status from conditional to a full-fledged charter, the company said.

items.title: SpaceX proposes a $24 billion Texas supercomputer and a gas plant
items.summary: The $24 billion project, which includes an AI supercomputer in Texas with its own gas-fired power plant, is about 17 times the value of SpaceX's bitcoin holdings.

items.title: Solana moves to scrap the transaction feature used in the $270 million Drift hack
items.summary: A draft proposal would end the 'durable nonces' feature no earlier than May 5, 2027, forcing custodians that sign offline to rebuild how they move coins.

items.title: Two rival Ethereum proposals aim to stop Glamsterdam breaking old contracts
items.summary: The proposals aim to keep Ethereum’s planned gas changes from breaking existing contracts, using different approaches to what contracts see and what users pay.

items.title: Binance's bitcoin mining pool finds just one block in a week as shutdown nears
items.summary: The exchange's once significant mining operation has nearly disappeared from Bitcoin's block-production rankings ahead of its November 10 closure.

items.title: Bitcoin drops as Nvidia cheating scandal and failed Iran talks trigger volatility
items.summary: Volatile price action has once again liquidated leveraged bullish plays worth millions.

items.title: Analysts see no broader ‘contagion’ from $6.3B Binance hack
items.summary: Binance’s pledge to cover all user losses helped contain the fallout from the $6.3 billion hack, analysts said.
